THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 07 My Ref. No.: වැලි/ඉ/2/5/අත්පත්/ඒ005 (අමතර). Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4/3/7/2011/HW/262.

I, hereby give notice under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, The Government intends to acquire the following land which are for a public purpose: Description of the Land to be Acquired: In the province of Uva, District of Badulla, Divisional Secretariat of Welimada, Minor Division of Udapalatha Korela, Grama Niladhari Division of Gawarammana, Village of Gawarammana, Survey General FVP 514, Supplement No. 9, Paper No. 9 and dated on 23.10.2018 Base Plot Number from 714 to 715, Total extent 0.0238 Hectares the details as follow:

01. Lot No. 714 Name of the Land: Kadewaththa; Land Details : Home Garden with mixed Cultivation and a part of permanent building; Claimant: Government; Original Claimant: Manathunga Bandara Mudiyanselage Vijithasiri Bandara Gawarammana, Vidurupola, Keppetipola; Extent : 0.0101 Hectare. 02. Lot No. 715 Name of the Land: Kadewaththa; Land Details : Home Garden with mixed Cultivation and a part of permanent
building; Claimant: Government; Original Claimant: Manathunga Mudiyanselage Wasanthi Probodha Gawarammana, Gawarammana, Keppetipola; Extent : 0.0137 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at the Divisional Secretariat Office, Welimada on the date and time relevant ot each land lot as Writing (in duplicate) on or before the 14th day of January, 2019, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, and the amount of computation and the details of the compensation of Such amount. Date Time Lot Numbers 14.01.2019 10.00 a.m. From 714 to 715
W.M.C.WEERASINGHE, Divisional Secretary , Welimada.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Welimada. On 19th December, 2018.
